mapper.select: SELECT branch_id AS branchId, branch_name AS branchName, latitude, longitude FROM kb_branch WHERE is_active = 1 AND geocoded_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT branch_id AS branchId, branch_name AS branchName, latitude, longitude FROM kb_branch WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO kb_ticket_counter (branch_id, desk_type_code, current_number, business_date) VALUES (#{branchId}, #{deskTypeCode}, 0, #{businessDate})
mapper.select: SELECT desk_type_code AS deskTypeCode, desk_type_name AS deskTypeName, prefix, is_operating AS operating FROM kb_desk_type WHERE desk_type_code = #{deskTypeCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_ticket (branch_id, desk_type_code, service_type, ticket_number, user_id, status, business_date) VALUES (#{branchId}, #{deskTypeCode}, #{serviceType}, #{ticketNumber}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{businessDate})
mapper.select: SELECT ticket_id AS ticketId, branch_id AS branchId, desk_type_code AS deskTypeCode, service_type AS serviceType, ticket_number AS ticketNumber, user_id AS userId, status, business_date AS businessDate FROM kb_ticket WHERE branch_id = #{branchId} AND desk_type_code = #{deskTypeCode} AND business_date = #{businessDate} AND status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY ticket_number ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_ticket SET status = 'CALLED', called_at = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND status = 'WAITING'
